items.title: Reindeer Delivering Cards by a Holiday Post
items.alt: Cartoon reindeer in a blue bow and saddlebag trotting beside a red-and-white decorative post with a blank envelope-shaped plaque.
items.description: Cream cards with small festive symbols peek from the blue satchel. The reindeer's raised foreleg and the plaque's red seal give the delivery scene a clear focal point.

items.title: Reindeer with a Bird on Its Antler
items.alt: Shaggy charcoal-brown cartoon reindeer bust looking up at a tiny red-breasted brown bird perched on one antler branch.
items.description: The small bird grips the outer branch above the reindeer's surprised face. A long cream muzzle, pale eyebrows and narrow red neckband distinguish the wide head-and-shoulders portrait.
